signals.text: Our school delivers a broad and balanced curriculum, including the core subjects of English, maths and science, alongside additional curriculum areas that promote creativity, independence and personal development.

Learners will follow personalised pathways in Key Stage 4 that may include Entry Level qualifications, Functional Skills, GCSEs and vocational awards such as BTECs, depending on ability and aspiration.
The science curriculum in all maintained schools also includes content on human development, including reproduction, which there is no right to withdraw from.
